Subject: POC plan & RACI  Redwood trial for Medicura Health

Hi Sanjay and Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the 3-week trial we discussed. Please review and confirm owners/timelines so we can kick off next week.

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood inference for Medicura clinical routing use case with production-like data and latency under 150ms p50 for typical requests.

Success criteria (draft)
1) Functional: Model passes 90% of our curated test prompts for entity extraction and intent classification relevant to clinical routing.
2) Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 450ms for target payloads under normal load.
3) Stability: 72-hour run with no more than 0.5% error rate and autoscaling behaving as expected.
4) Security/compliance: data residency validation and no PII exfiltration; SOC2 evidence review complete.
5) Ops: Infra connectivity validated and one end-to-end inference via VPC peering or secure VPN.

Evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (prep): Network connectivity, credentials, and test dataset exchange.
- Week 1: Baseline runs and initial tuning (latency/cost tradeoffs).
- Week 2: Stability and load runs, end-to-end validation.
- Week 3: Buffer for remediation and wrap-up, deliverable: success report and suggested production config.

Draft RACI (please confirm names)
- Infra/Network: R = Medicura Cloud Ops (Olivia Chen), A = Medicura IT Lead, C = Redwood SE (Aditya Rao), I = Prod Eng
- App/Integration: R = Medicura App Team, A = Sanjay Mehta, C = Redwood AE (Dylan Brooks), I = CS (Lauren Bishop)
- Security/Compliance: R = Medicura Security (Sanjay Mehta), A = Medicura CISO, C = Redwood Security, I = Procurement
- Procurement/PO/Terms: R = Medicura Procurement, A = Medicura Finance, C = Redwood Legal, I = Account Team

Attachments: medicura-poc-success-criteria.pdf (attached). I also pushed a folder to Drive (link below) with the proposed test prompts and measurement dashboard.

Requested next steps
- Please confirm owners above or propose edits by EOD Thu 3/19.
- Confirm if you prefer VPC peering or site-to-site VPN for the infra connectivity.
- If procurement needs an initial SOW or commercial estimate, let me know and I will loop Legal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
